calculation_checks.lesson_anchor: Centre of gravity and the moment of a force > Force arrows and weight
calculation_checks.independent_check: W = mg with g = 9.81 N kg^-1; mass in kg multiplied by g gives weight in N.

calculation_checks.lesson_anchor: Centre of gravity and the moment of a force > Defining the moment of a force > Worked Example 2: Calculating a direct moment
calculation_checks.independent_check: M = F d_perp = 45 N x 0.28 m = 12.6 N m; rounded to two significant figures gives 13 N m clockwise.

calculation_checks.lesson_anchor: Centre of gravity and the moment of a force > Forces that produce zero moment > Worked Example 3: Force directed through a pivot
calculation_checks.independent_check: d_perp = 0 m because line of action passes through pivot P; M = 80 N x 0 m = 0 N m.

calculation_checks.lesson_anchor: Centre of gravity and the moment of a force > The turning effect of an object's weight > Worked Example 4: Moment of a horizontal beam's weight
calculation_checks.independent_check: W = 6.5 kg x 9.81 N kg^-1 = 63.765 N. Centre of gravity at 1.20 m from left; pivot at 0.40 m; d_perp = 1.20 - 0.40 = 0.80 m. M = 63.765 N x 0.80 m = 51.012 N m; rounded to two significant figures gives 51 N m clockwise.

calculation_checks.lesson_anchor: Centre of gravity and the moment of a force > Perpendicular distance for angled bodies and forces > Worked Example 5: Moment of an inclined sign
calculation_checks.independent_check: W = 8.0 kg x 9.81 N kg^-1 = 78.48 N. Sign at 35 deg to horizontal; d_perp = 0.75 m x cos(35 deg) = 0.61436... m. M = 78.48 N x 0.61436 m = 48.215 N m; rounded to two significant figures gives 48 N m clockwise.

calculation_checks.lesson_anchor: Centre of gravity and the moment of a force > Solving for force or distance > Worked Example 6: Rearranging for force and distance
calculation_checks.independent_check: (a) F = M / d_perp = 42 N m / 0.35 m = 120 N. (b) d_perp = M / F = 42 N m / 150 N = 0.28 m. Units and dimensions cancel correctly.
